gloss: to write in, to fill in, to post (online)

definitions.gloss: to write in, to fill in
definitions.explanation: To write information into a form, document, or blank space.
To write a comment or message on a website, bulletin board, or social media.

examples.japanese: {申込書|もうしこみしょ}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}き{込|こ}んでください。
examples.english: Please fill in your name on the application form.

examples.japanese: {教科書|きょうかしょ}にメモを{書|か}き{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I wrote notes in the textbook.

examples.japanese: SNSに{毎日|まいにち}{書|か}き{込|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: I post on social media every day.

notes:
{書|か}き{込|こ}む is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to write into something or post online.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {書|か}く (to write) + {込|こ}む (into) → to write into

ASPECT (ている):
{書|か}き{込|こ}んでいる indicates an ongoing action of writing/posting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {書類|しょるい}に{書|か}き{込|こ}む (fill in a document)
- フォームに{書|か}き{込|こ}む (fill in a form)
- 掲示板に{書|か}き{込|こ}む (post on a bulletin board)
- SNSに{書|か}き{込|こ}む (post on social media)

RELATED NOUN:
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み: a post, comment, entry (especially online)

MODERN USAGE:
In the internet age, {書|か}き{込|こ}む is commonly used for posting comments or messages online. {書|か}き{込|こ}み refers to such online posts or comments.

[Register: Neutral]
